fullPassage: In modern societies, the performing arts form a distinct category of public entertainment in opposition to the mass distribution through the media of expertly staged performances which have been recorded and edited. By contrast, theater, ballet, circus, concert, rodeo, storytelling, etc., unfold their signs in real space and time, and engage audiences who respond cognitively and emotionally on the spot. Performers and audiences are involved in shared enjoyment. But sometimes frustration occurs within the boundaries of such ritualistic events. In industrialized and computerized cultures, the performing arts become economically unstable because the institutions which sustain them increasingly depend on public and corporate funding. However, they retain their power of fascination for large, if not massive audiences, who prize the experiential, risk-loaded and one-time event quality they afford. In traditional and local cultures, performances still survive and provide their audiences with a unique fulfillment in smaller scale, economically sustainable institutional settings.

By contrast, theater, ballet, circus, concert, rodeo, storytelling, etc., unfold their signs in real space and time, and engage audiences who respond cognitively and emotionally on the spot. Performers and audiences are involved in shared enjoyment. But sometimes frustration occurs within the boundaries of such ritualistic events. In industrialized and computerized cultures, the performing arts become economically unstable because the institutions which sustain them increasingly depend on public and corporate funding. However, they retain their power of fascination for large, if not massive audiences, who prize <u>the experiential, risk-loaded and one-time event quality they afford</u>. In traditional and local cultures, performances still survive and provide their audiences with a unique fulfillment in smaller scale, economically sustainable institutional settings.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① 녹화된 미디어보다 제작 비용이 저렴한 특성: 비용 아님

✅ ② 직접 경험하고, 예측 불가능하며, 다시 재현할 수 없는 공연의 고유한 가치: experiential=직접 경험, risk-loaded=예측 불가, one-time=재현 불가 ← 정답

❌ ③ 관객이 공연에 직접 참여하여 내용을 결정하는 특성: 내용 결정 아님

❌ ④ 대규모 관객을 동원할 수 있는 상업적 잠재력: 상업적 잠재력이 아닌 예술적 가치
det.tip: experiential=경험적, risk-loaded=예측불가, one-time=일회성

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① 일치: 'unfold their signs in real space and time' — 실시간 전개

❌ ② 일치: 'frustration occurs within the boundaries of such ritualistic events' — 의식적 행사 경계에서 좌절

❌ ③ 일치: 'still survive and provide their audiences with a unique fulfillment' — 전통 문화 존속

✅ ④ 불일치: 불안정의 원인은 관객 관심 감소가 아니라 공적·기업 자금 의존 ← 정답
det.tip: 불안정 원인 = 자금 의존, 관객 관심 감소 아님

ch: 공연 예술은 실시간 공간과 시간 속에서 기호를 펼친다.
의식적 행사의 경계 안에서 때때로 좌절감이 발생한다.
전통 문화에서 공연은 소규모 환경에서 여전히 존속한다.
공연 예술의 경제적 불안정은 관객의 관심 감소에서 비롯된다.
